Description: Verify GET /passes/{id} returns 404 'pass not found' when id is non-numeric ('abc') — id validated before any DB query (B1)
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. JSON contains {'detail': 'pass not found'}

Description: Verify GET /passes/{id} returns 404 'pass not found' when id is a decimal ('1.5') — a number sent as a string that is not a base-10 positive integer
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. JSON contains {'detail': 'pass not found'}

Description: Verify GET /passes/{id} returns 404 'pass not found' when id is one past Postgres integer max ('2147483648') without querying the database
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. JSON contains {'detail': 'pass not found'}

Description: Verify GET /passes/{id} returns 404 'pass not found' when id is far out of Postgres integer range ('99999999999') without leaking a DB error
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. JSON contains {'detail': 'pass not found'}

Description: Verify GET /passes/{id} returns 404 'pass not found' when id is the max in-range integer ('2147483647') but no passes row exists
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. JSON contains {'detail': 'pass not found'}

Description: Verify GET /passes/{id} returns 200 with the stored pass body for an existing in-range id (DB injected via buildApp, real DB read)
PreRequisites: Execute SQL: INSERT INTO passes (id, vehicle, months, plate, price, txn_id, status) VALUES (<dynamic_id>, 'car', 3, 'ABC123', 4500, 'txn_1', 'ACTIVE');
Post-Assertions: Execute SQL: SELECT count(*) FROM passes WHERE id = <dynamic_id> -> Expected: 1
Teardown: Execute SQL: DELETE FROM passes WHERE id = <dynamic_id>;

Description: Verify GET /passes/{id} returns 500 'internal error' (no raw DB error or stack trace leaked) when the database raises an unexpected error
Steps: Call GET /passes/<dynamic_id> while the passes table is unavailable (simulate a database error, e.g. drop/rename the passes table for the duration of the call)
ExpectedResult: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error. JSON contains {'detail': 'internal error'}
